decisions.proposal: Preserve browser Web Push; select a supported native transport/bridge and current provider registration protocol only after actual app identity/toolchain/provider prerequisites are verified.

Bind current device association to authenticated immutable user, permit only own mutations and safe logout/account switch across all surfaces; explicit failure/recovery and retention rules remain to be accepted.

decisions.topic: Detailed preview authority and queued privacy
decisions.proposal: Preserve existing preview-off default; define workspace versus recipient/device authority and revalidate/redact queued content at send/display boundaries, without inventing a new adopted policy.
Map actual reminder/Admin/invitation in-app versus push paths, suppression/read behavior and badges; do not silently add invitation push or native notification guarantees.
Choose observable at-least-once/partial-device/recovery semantics and durable claim ownership, without promising exactly-once OS display or changing retry limits blindly.
Retain current no-private-data offline fallback, manual page refresh and safe in-flight behavior; separately review immediate worker activation/multiple tabs/native update limits.
Reauthorize current user/workspace/source/role at open; reject foreign/stale/deleted targets, preserve legitimate sign-in intent and last-workspace behavior without conferring authority.

Agree supported browser/PWA/native/device states and real provider/environment/retention/monitoring boundaries before isolated delivery and final release tests; no SDK/cloud credential setup is inferred.
